audio.text: Good morning. I'm waiting for a package that came by ship. Has it arrived yet?
Yes. The ship came in last night. Your package is in Warehouse B.
Great. Can I pick it up today?
Of course, but please bring your ID card. The office closes at five.
OK. I'll come in the afternoon.

questions.q: Why does the woman visit the port office?

why.vi: Cô ấy hỏi gói hàng đi tàu đã đến chưa, tức là hỏi về một gói hàng.
why.en: She asks if her package has arrived by ship, so she is asking about a package.

questions.trap: Cô ấy không mua vé tàu; chỉ nói gói hàng đến bằng tàu.

questions.q: What does the man tell the woman to bring?

why.vi: Người đàn ông nói "bring your ID card", đáp án giữ nguyên ý này.
why.en: The man says to bring an ID card.

questions.trap: Không ai nhắc tới receipt hay boarding pass.

questions.q: When will the woman probably return to the office?

why.vi: Cô ấy nói "I'll come in the afternoon".
why.en: She says she will come in the afternoon.

questions.trap: "Last night" là lúc tàu đến, không phải lúc cô ấy quay lại.
